meta.name: video-dubbing
meta.description: Reference for the studio/dubbing service — the Kurdish Sorani to Iraqi Arabic video dubbing pipeline. Use this for any task involving audio/video processing, Demucs, transcription, translation prompts, TTS providers, or FFmpeg reassembly. Covers which TTS providers are licensed for client work and which are not.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速获取库尔德语到阿拉伯语视频配音的完整流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在制作库尔德语到阿拉伯语的配音视频。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly learn the full pipeline for dubbing videos from Kurdish to Arabic.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are producing a dubbed video from Kurdish to Arabic.

howto.what: Claude 会提供『库尔德语索拉尼→伊拉克阿拉伯语』配音流程参考：Demucs 分离人声/背景、Gemini 转写、MiniMax 翻译、TTS 合成、FFmpeg 对齐混音，并说明各 TTS 提供商的商用许可。
howto.when: 当任务涉及音频/视频处理、Demucs、转写等环节，或询问 TTS 商用许可时触发。

say.text: 这个库尔德语视频要配成伊拉克阿拉伯语，流程怎么走？
say.note: 会给出完整的处理步骤

say.text: MiniMax 和 Chatterbox 哪个能用于客户项目？
say.note: 会按商用许可说明可用与暂不用的提供商

say.text: 索拉尼对白转伊拉克方言时，翻译提示词该怎么写？

howto.what_en: Claude will act as a reference for the Kurdish Sorani → Iraqi Arabic dubbing pipeline: Demucs to split vocals/background, Gemini transcription, MiniMax translation, TTS synthesis, FFmpeg alignment/remix, plus notes on which TTS providers are commercially licensed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task involves audio/video processing, Demucs, transcription/translation prompts, TTS providers, or FFmpeg reassembly, or when asking about commercial TTS licensing.

say_en.text: How do I dub this Kurdish video into Iraqi Arabic?
Which TTS can I use for client work, MiniMax or Chatterbox?
say_en.note: Clarifies licensed vs. not licensed providers.

say_en.text: How should the translation prompt be written for Sorani to Iraqi Arabic?
say_en.note: Lists dialect, tone, and timing requirements.
